v_25.source: a cold disc reads near the top of the ADC's range: no foldback

v_85.source: the firmware's foldback threshold, 1.58 V for 85 C: the NTC's +-1 % in R25 and B and R8's 0.1 % move it under 2 C

v_105.source: the firmware's limit, 1.085 V for 105 C, under the LEDs' 105 C solder point (Bridgelux DS207, p.4) and the module's 105 C (ESP32-C6-MINI-1-H4)

sens_mv.source: 15 mV per C or more near 85 C: 18 counts of the C6's 12-bit ADC (0.8 mV), a reading to 0.1 C
